sections.title: Queue decisions and routing
sections.responsibility: Validate queue state and select the next action, worker and reviewer. Includes ordering, retry/escalation and parallelism rules. CLI side effects belong to the integration section.

sections.title: Outcome recording and queue persistence
sections.responsibility: Translate worker statuses, reviews and Paddock task observations into queue state. The record CLI writes the queue through a temporary file and replacement.

sections.title: Progress and stall observations
sections.responsibility: Compare task progress observations and distinguish finished, capacity-waiting and stalled work. The watcher reads task records and emits status; it does not itself stop a worker.

sections.title: CLI and Paddock integration
sections.responsibility: Adapt decisions into Paddock tool-call text, append event logs and optionally notify through a configured bridge. The default CLI executor and Paddock mode differ; emitting a tool call is not executing it.
